name: Magali Botanical Hair Oil
shortDescription: A nutrient-rich botanical hair oil infused with 14 herbal botanicals and 3 natural oils to nourish the scalp and roots, support stronger-looking hair, improve softness and manageability, and add natural shine.
overview: Transform your hair-care routine from root to tip with Magali Botanical Hair Oil. The client-supplied formula combines 14 botanical infusions with olive, castor, and coconut oils. It is positioned for all hair textures, including natural, color-treated, and chemically processed hair.
benefits: Nourishes the scalp and hair roots
Supports stronger-looking hair and reduced breakage
Helps smooth frizz and improve manageability
Suitable for all hair types and textures
directions: Apply a small amount directly to the scalp and hair.
Massage gently into the scalp for 3–5 minutes.
Leave in as a daily treatment or wash out with shampoo if preferred.
Use 3–4 times per week for best results.
caution: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. Discontinue use if irritation occurs. Keep out of reach of children.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.

name: Magali PureHeal Oil
shortDescription: A botanical oil blend made with cold-pressed castor oil and pure clove essential oil, positioned by the client for targeted external comfort and moisture support.
overview: Magali PureHeal Oil combines cold-pressed castor oil and pure clove essential oil in a 60 ml amber dropper bottle. The current client materials position it for external topical use on dry or irritated skin, lip-area discomfort, and areas experiencing everyday muscle or joint stiffness.
benefits: Helps soothe and moisturize dry, rough, or irritated skin
Provides a warming botanical sensation from clove essential oil
Convenient dropper format for targeted application
Can be massaged into areas of everyday muscle or joint stiffness
directions: Dispense a few drops onto clean fingertips or a cotton swab.
Apply directly to the external target area.
Use 2–3 times daily or as needed.
caution: For external use only. Avoid direct contact with eyes. Keep out of reach of children. Discontinue use if irritation occurs.
storage: Use the storage directions shown on the final approved label once confirmed.
complianceNote: Client materials include stronger relief/medical-style claims. Review final public wording before launch, especially references to cold sores, oral discomfort, and muscle/joint relief.

name: Magali Herbal Hair Grease
shortDescription: A rich herbal hair grease made with traditional herbs, natural oils, and shea butter to nourish the scalp, support stronger-looking hair, add shine, and improve manageability.
overview: Magali Herbal Hair Grease is a botanical hair-care formula built around herbs, oils, and shea butter. Current label messaging emphasizes scalp nourishment, stronger-looking hair, shine, everyday care, and suitability for all hair types.
benefits: Helps hair feel soft and manageable
directions: Take a small amount and apply evenly to scalp and hair.
Use 1–3 times a week for best results.
caution: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. If irritation occurs, discontinue use. Keep out of reach of children.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.
verificationNote: Client called this an 8 oz jar, while the supplied working label states 185 g / 6.5 oz. Keep 185 g / 6.5 oz as the temporary website value until confirmed.

name: Magali Caribbean Style Beef Pies — 8 Pack
shortDescription: A family-size 8-pack of frozen Caribbean-style beef pies with a flaky pastry crust and savory seasoned ground-beef filling.
overview: Bring home the savory flavors of the Caribbean with Magali Caribbean Style Beef Pies. The current client and packaging materials describe an 8-pack family-size frozen product designed for convenient oven, air-fryer, or pan-fry preparation.
benefits: Oven, air fryer, or skillet preparation
Keep frozen until ready to cook

directions.oven: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Place frozen patties on a parchment-lined baking tray. Bake 25–30 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden brown and fully heated.
directions.airFryer: Preheat air fryer to 350°F (175°C). Place patties in a single layer and cook 15–18 minutes, flipping halfway through, until crispy and heated through.
directions.skillet: Heat 2–3 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium heat. Place frozen patties directly into hot oil and cook 6–8 minutes per side until golden and fully cooked.

caution: Always ensure patties reach an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C) before serving. Cooking times may vary depending on oven, air fryer, or stove.
verificationNote: Confirm final customer-facing naming (pies vs patties/pasties), allergen statement, and frozen-shipping method before launch.
